title: Panel Value
summary: Official Derivative reference for Panel Values, the per-panel state values that change through user interaction, virtual clicks, Panel CHOP access, PanelValue Python access, panel() expressions, and Panel Execute DAT callbacks.
guidance: Use this article when panel interaction state must be inspected, converted to CHOP channels, watched by callbacks, or accessed from Python or expressions.
Panel CHOP does not display string values or instant values that pulse to a value and then return to 0 or empty; use Panel Execute DAT or PanelValue access when those transitions matter.
Treat display, enable, and focusselect as readonly panel values; use PanelCOMP.setFocus when a script needs to change panel focus.
The key value pulses the ASCII code followed by 0; use Keyboard In DAT for keys without ASCII values.
Node Viewers do not affect screenw or screenh, and multiple viewers can conflict, so use those values carefully when sizing TOP renders from panel windows.
stateu and statev may be obsolete; prefer u, v, trueu, and truev unless slider Zone, Range, or Clamp semantics are specifically needed.
For drag-and-drop workflows, pair drag, drop, dragrollover, dragrollu, and dragrollv with panel drop settings and PanelCOMP.dropReady.
